bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · back above the 10-day, under the 100-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 重回 10 日均线上方，受制于 100 日均线

read.en: TSMC rose 1.4% on Oct 26 to $424.37, trading between $417.72 and $428.85. It is just above the falling 5-day ($422.4) and 10-day ($424.2) averages, below the falling 30-day ($442.6) and 100-day ($429.6), and above the rising 200-day ($398.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and is below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($434.50), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: 台积电 10月26日上涨 1.4%，收于 $424.37，盘中区间 $417.72–428.85。股价略高于下行的 5 日（$422.4）和 10 日均线（$424.2），低于下行的 30 日（$442.6）和 100 日均线（$429.6），高于上行的 200 日均线（$398.2）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$434.50），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The close cleared $421.9 (Oct 22 high), now support; the high stalled under the 100-day. Resistance is $428.9–429.6 (Oct 26 high, 100-day), then $434.5–435.2 (SAR, Oct 21 high) and $442.6 (30-day). Support is $421.9–424.2 (5 and 10-day, Oct 22 high), then $417.7 (Oct 26 low) and $412.5 (Sep 15 low). A close above $429.6 would target $435; a close below $417.7 would reopen $412.5.
